data.gender_notes: Juveria is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful name derived from the Arabic word 'Jawhar' meaning gem, jewel or treasure. Juveria is a name of great elegance and charm, evoking images of precious stones and beautiful flowers. The name Juveria carries the meaning “Gem” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Juveria usually hope their child will grow to embody gem and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Juveria belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gem.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juveria total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Juveria

Historically, Juveria was one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad. The name holds spiritual significance and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing beauty, piety, and grace. It is cherished across various Muslim cultures for its religious and aesthetic connotations
